No comments or suggestions have been received from the general public in response to the aforesaid notices published in the newspapers by the Petitioner. 9. It has been observed that the Commission vide RoP for the hearing dated 19.8.2025 directed the Respondents to file their respective replies to the amended Petition, if not already filed, within two weeks, with an advance copy to the Petitioner, who may file its rejoinder within a week thereafter. However, Bihar State Power (Holding) Company Limited (BSPHCL), Respondent No. 1, has filed its reply/written submission dated 7.10.2025, much beyond the timeline given by the Commission and the Petitioner also filed its rejoinder to the same on 15.10.2025, in the window other than the reply/Rejoinder window of the e-filing portal, without the approval of the Commission. Since BSPHCL and the Petitioner have not complied with the Commission’s direction, we are not inclined to consider the reply/written submissions filed by BSPHCL, and the Petitioner’s rejoinder thereto in this order. 11.
